name: Where Now
source:
Reeling from a series of unfortunate events that left him isolated and alone the previous year, wolfhound, ram mix Ros now struggles to move forward into this new and unexpected part of his life, helped and hindered by his biggest critique and number one fan, himself and, perhaps, someone new.

[From [url=https://bandanadog.itch.io/where-now]Itch.io[/url]]
